 "content": "from collections import Counter

def transform(grid):
    h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0])
    # identify separators, which form solid zero/background-color bands
    sep_rows=[r for r in range(h) if len(set(grid[r]))==1]
    sep_cols=[c for c in range(w) if len({grid[r][c] for r in range(h)})==1]
    def spans(n, cuts):
        out=[]; start=0
        for x in cuts+[n]:
            if x>start: out.append(list(range(start,x)))
            start=x+1
        return out
    rgs=spans(h,sep_rows); cgs=spans(w,sep_cols)
    vals=[grid[r][c] for rr in rgs for cc in cgs for r in rr for c in cc]
    bg=Counter(vals).most_common(1)[0][0]
    marks=[v for v in set(vals) if v!=bg]
    mark=Counter(v for rr in rgs for cc in cgs for r in rr for c in cc for v in [grid[r][c]] if v!=bg).most_common(1)[0][0]
    return [[1 if sum(grid[r][c]==mark for r in rr for c in cc)==2 else bg for cc in cgs] for rr in rgs]
"
}

    rg,cg=groups(h,row_sep),groups(w,col_sep)
    content=[grid[r][c] for rr in rg for cc in cg for r in rr for c in cc]
    bg=Counter(content).most_common(1)[0][0]
    nonbg=[x for x in content if x!=bg]
    mark=Counter(nonbg).most_common(1)[0][0]
    return [[1 if sum(grid[r][c]==mark for r in rr for c in cc)==2 else bg for cc in cg] for rr in rg]
"
